Identified - We have new information regarding the incident that affected your service(s).

Please find below an update on the situation:
Update : Our technical team is currently working to restore the vMAC addresses affected by the incident. The IP range concerned is: 178.33.0.0/19

If the customer has not made any changes to their configuration, we will attempt to restore the original vMAC address.

However, if the customer has moved the IP configuration or recreated a vMAC address, we will not intervene, as the configuration has been modified by the customer.

If we are able to restore the original vMAC address, its description will most likely be set to "OVH". Otherwise, the client will be responsible for setting the description themselves.
Ongoing Actions : The incident has been identified and our teams are mobilised to restore service as quickly as possible.
